ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Potential Wrongdoing in Sports Team Sales
ideas.description: Investigate the financial dealings behind high-profile sports team sales, including the recent sale of the Los Angeles Lakers
questions: What are the potential implications of the federal investigation into Mark Walter?
How common are federal probes into sports team owners?
ideas.insight: The recent sale of the Los Angeles Lakers has raised questions about the potential for wrongdoing in high-profile sports team sales, highlighting the need for increased scrutiny and investigative reporting
